rules.rationale: N/O sites donate and accept hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy.
Pure hydrocarbons pay cavity-formation cost with no compensating polar solvation.
Halogens raise hydrophobicity and disrupt water hydrogen bonding despite added polarizability.
Counter-prior: reverses the weak negative smiles_mid source effect; moderate length permits more polar groups.

skills.hypothesis: Hydration ranking is set by polar hydrogen-bonding capacity, not molecular size; this skill keeps the polarity-first prior that led development seeds but decays semantic mass faster so revealed target outcomes dominate sooner. Fails if the score rewards small apolar solutes or hetero_high coverage is unrepresentative.

rules.rationale: Ring role had highest transfer weight (0.76); saturated acyclic solutes avoid rigid hydrophobic ring desolvation penalties.
Non-aromatic solutes lack delocalized apolar surfaces that raise cavity-formation cost in water.
Explicit source value prior: smiles_short carried the largest positive solubility effect in the transfer table.
Explicit source value prior: smiles_long carried the largest negative effect, consistent with poor hydration of large solutes.

skills.hypothesis: The two highest-transfer-weight source roles (ring, and rotatable-bond-to-branch) plus the explicit smiles-length value priors carry partly real hydration signal, since size and rigidity also govern cavity cost. May fail because ESOL effects blend crystal-lattice terms absent from pure hydration and source confidences are only 0.22-0.41.

lesson: The polarity-first hydration prior beat the source-transfer prior on every development seed (mean AUC 77.6 vs 51.8), confirming that hydrogen-bonding capacity rather than solubility size/ring terms drives this target; retaining that skill and trimming its semantic mass keeps the win while giving revealed target data more influence. The source-grounded alternative is kept only as a diversified hedge, not as a deployment candidate, because eight seeds are too few to rule out real signal in the ring and size terms.
revision_summary: Retained polar_hydration_counter_prior essentially intact as polar_hbond_hydration_prior, lowering semantic_mass_end from 0.2 to 0.12 so the surrogate mass decays faster toward the anchor. Replaced the source-order skill with aromatic_low_ring_source_prior, which grounds itself in the explicit smiles_length value priors and the aromatic/ring descriptors tied to the highest-transfer-weight source roles, giving an orthogonal cavity-cost view as the counter-hypothesis hedge. Both skills use catalog-exact field/value pairs, four rules or fewer, and decaying semantic mass; deployed the polarity-first skill.
